title: GAIA Agent Hub Per-Agent Manifest
description: Aggregate manifest served at GET /agents/<id>/manifest.json. Holds full display metadata plus every published version. Source of truth for version immutability. Field names mirror gaia-agent.yaml (docs/spec/agent-hub-restructure.mdx) and src/gaia/hub/manifest.py.

type.description: Package kind (#1716). Absent on manifests stored before it was recorded, which were published as "agent". Skills have their own manifest and never appear here.

tools_count.description: Number of tools the agent registers; 0 when the manifest omits it.

permissions.description: Declared permission strings; empty array when the manifest omits them.

latest_version.description: The stable channel. Empty only while the package has next versions and no stable one; such a package is left out of index.json.

deprecation_message.description: Only present when the latest version's manifest declares one.

npm_package.description: npm package name when the agent is distributed via npm; absent otherwise.

playground_url.description: Localhost playground URL served by the agent's sidecar; absent otherwise.

channels.description: The version each release channel resolves to. Absent on manifests written before channels existed, where stable is latest_version and next is the same.

stable.description: Always equal to latest_version (empty while only next versions exist).

next.description: The newest version in versions or next_versions.

versions.description: Map of version string -> published version entry, stable channel only. A client that installs the newest entry here never gets a release candidate.

next_versions.description: Versions published to the next channel only (release candidates). Absent until the first next publish.

requirements.description: Always fully populated: numbers default to 0 and npu to false when the uploaded gaia-agent.yaml omits them.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 generated server-side by the Worker.

min_gaia_version.description: Oldest GAIA core this version runs on, from its own gaia-agent.yaml. Absent on versions published before it was recorded; for the latest version a client then reads the top-level min_gaia_version.

artifact.description: Primary artifact (first published for this version). Kept for catalog display and single-artifact (wheel) agents.

artifacts.description: Every artifact published under this version (one per platform for native binary releases). Append-only per distinct filename.
